description: This file contains serialization utility functions for string conversions, hex/binary/base64 encoding, UTF-16/UTF-32 conversions, and related helper methods within the WPEFramework Core namespace.
published: WPEFramework::Core::FromString(const std::string&, uint8_t[], uint16_t&, const TCHAR*)

methods.name: string ToString(const char realString[],unsigned int length)
methods.description: Converts wide-character string to std::string using wcstombs if __CORE_NO_WCHAR_SUPPORT__ is not defined.

methods.name: string ToString(const wchar_t realString[],unsigned int length)
methods.description: Converts char string to std::wstring using mbstowcs if __CORE_NO_WCHAR_SUPPORT__ is not defined.

methods.name: void ToString(const char realString[],std::wstring & result)
methods.description: Converts wchar_t array to std::string, with consideration for UNICODE setting.

methods.name: void ToString(const uint8_t object[],const uint16_t length,const bool padding,string & result)
methods.description: Converts char array to std::string with specified length, considering UNICODE setting.

methods.name: void EXTERNAL ToHexString(const uint8_t object[],const uint16_t length,string & result)
methods.description: Converts a binary object to a hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: uint16_t EXTERNAL FromHexString(const string & hexString,uint8_t * object,const uint16_t maxLength)
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string back to binary object array.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a base64 string, with optional padding.

methods.name: uint16_t FromString(const string & newValue,uint8_t object[],uint16_t & length,const TCHAR * ignoreList)
methods.description: Decodes a base64 string into binary object array, may skip ignore characters.

methods.name: bool CodePointToUTF16(const uint32_t codePoint,uint16_t & lowPart,uint16_t & highPart)
methods.description: Converts a Unicode code point into UTF-16 surrogate pair.

methods.name: bool UTF16ToCodePoint(const uint16_t lowPart,const uint16_t highPart,uint32_t & codePoint)
methods.description: Converts UTF-16 surrogate pair back into a Unicode code point.

methods.name: int8_t ToCodePoint(const TCHAR * data,const uint8_t length,uint32_t & codePoint)
methods.description: Decodes a UTF-8 sequence into a Unicode code point.

methods.name: int8_t FromCodePoint(uint32_t codePoint,TCHAR * data,const uint8_t length)
methods.description: Encodes a Unicode code point into UTF-8 sequence.

methods.name: string EXTERNAL ToQuotedString(const TCHAR quote,const string & input)
methods.description: Returns a version of the string with internal quote characters escaped, suitable for JSON-like quoting.
